3D PROTOTYPE · NEON YARD
P1: A/D move · W jump · S block/down · J light (L) · K heavy (H) · L grab · I counter · U Mode → U again = special
Strings: chain L/H on hit (e.g. L·L·H, L·H·H — every fighter has 2 signature strings, see select screen) · Fwd+H haymaker · Back+H launcher uppercut (juggle after!) · Down+L low kick · Down+H sweep · L/H in air = flying kick · Down+L/H near a downed foe = stomp
Grab: L while holding = knee/punch (×3) · H or L = throw (hold Back to throw behind) · near the fence = wall slam · when grabbed: mash any button to break
P2: Arrows + Numpad 1 light · 2 heavy · 3 grab · 5 counter · 4 mode · Phone: on-screen buttons (◀▶ + H for directional heavies) · Esc: title
